recipe.title: Easy Egg Curry

steps.text: In a kadai heat oil, ghee. Add black cardamom, cinnamon stick, bay leave, cloves and cumin seeds saute well.
steps.label: Toast spices

steps.text: Add onion and saute till it become translucent. Add ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and saute well add kasuri methi, tomato and saute well till the masala gets cooked.
steps.label: Cook masala

steps.text: Add Â¼ cup water and let it cooked, add 1 egg yolk boiled so the gravy gets thicken. Add salt to taste and let it cook.
steps.label: Make gravy

steps.text: In a pan, Add oil, boiled and pricked egg , red chilli powder, turmeric powder and saute till colour appear an keep it aside.
steps.label: Spice boiled eggs

steps.text: For omelet, In a mixing bowl add eggs, turmeric powder, red chilli powder and salt to taste and mix them well.
steps.label: Mix omelet batter

steps.text: In another pan add oil pour the egg mixture and cook the omelette soft in texture.
steps.label: Cook omelette

steps.text: Serve the gravy in two form, one with boiled egg cut into half and serve hot.
steps.label: Serve with boiled eggs

steps.text: one with omelette cut into half.
steps.label: Serve with omelette

notes: The linked recipe's ingredient list only names 'Egg' though the instructions mention many spices and other items; ingredients were not invented.
The instructions assume boiled eggs already exist (eggs are referenced as 'boiled'); no explicit step to boil eggs is present in the source, so no such step was added.
Step 3 is marked producing the gravy component so later serving steps can consume it.
Freshness cue 'serve hot' was taken from the source text in the serving step(s).
